**Finding: Compliant — no redline proposed.**

The agreement imposes no liquidated damages, penalty, or early-termination fee on Juniper Ridge. Key points:

- **Searches came back clean:** "liquidated damages," "early termination," and "remaining" return nothing; "penalty" returns only §27.3, which runs in our favour (termination *without penalty* plus refund of prepaid Fees).
- **Termination sections (§§9, 10) carry no exit charge** — §10.2 actually obligates Vendor to refund prepaid recurring Fees and Fees for Services we cannot use due to Vendor's uncured breach.
- **§7.1** is ordinary Fees; **§22.2** audit-cost shifting on a >5% underpayment is a cost-recovery mechanic, not an LD.

This sits at the **preferred position** (no Customer-payable LD), not merely the fallback.

Two items noted in the rationale rather than flagged:
1. **§2.1 take-or-pay** (USD 2,000,000/year, "without reduction or termination rights") is the closest economic exposure, but it is a minimum-volume commitment properly handled under the minimum-commitment rule — flagging it here would double-count the same commercial term.
2. **Service credits are unverifiable** — the service-level exhibit referenced in §2.2 is not part of this document, so we cannot confirm credits run in our favour. Worth confirming before signature.
